``` {r}
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(dplyr)
library(tigris)
library(arrow)

options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)
sf_use_s2(FALSE)

pred_dir <- "Y:/Ryan Armstrong/Pollution Modeling/Ambiant Air Pollution/Input Data/Predictors"

prism_files <- c(
  file.path(pred_dir, "prismcompos.129.22.99.132.315.11.56.13.nc"), # tmax
  file.path(pred_dir, "prismcompos.129.22.99.132.315.11.57.5.nc"),  # tmin
  file.path(pred_dir, "prismcompos.129.22.99.132.315.11.58.39.nc")  # precip
)

out_dir <- "Y:/Ryan Armstrong/Pollution Modeling/Ambiant Air Pollution/Input Data/Processed/Phase1_PRISM_Grid"
if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE)

# master grid outputs
out_parquet <- file.path(out_dir, "prism_master_grid_allcells.parquet")
out_csv     <- file.path(out_dir, "prism_master_grid_allcells.csv")
out_gpkg    <- file.path(out_dir, "prism_master_grid_allcells.gpkg")
out_shp     <- file.path(out_dir, "prism_master_grid_allcells.shp")
out_tif     <- file.path(out_dir, "prism_template_rectified_flipped.tif")

# merged PRISM covariate outputs
out_prism_parquet <- file.path(out_dir, "prism_covariates_merged.parquet")
out_prism_csv     <- file.path(out_dir, "prism_covariates_merged.csv")
out_prism_gpkg    <- file.path(out_dir, "prism_covariates_merged.gpkg")
out_prism_shp     <- file.path(out_dir, "prism_covariates_merged.shp")

```


``` {r}
#----------------------------------
# Orientation check with first file
#----------------------------------
r_raw_check <- rast(prism_files[1])

r_fix <- project(r_raw_check[[1]], "EPSG:4326", method = "bilinear")
r_fix_flip <- flip(r_fix, direction = "vertical")

states_sf <- tigris::states(cb = TRUE, year = 2022) |>
  st_as_sf() |>
  filter(!STUSPS %in% c("AK","HI","PR","VI","GU","MP","AS")) |>
  st_transform(4326)

par(mfrow = c(1,2))
plot(r_fix, main = "Rectified")
plot(st_geometry(states_sf), add = TRUE, border = "red", lwd = 1)

plot(r_fix_flip, main = "Rectified + Vertical Flip")
plot(st_geometry(states_sf), add = TRUE, border = "red", lwd = 1)

#----------------------------------
# Build corrected PRISM template
#----------------------------------
r_raw <- rast(prism_files[1])

r_template <- project(r_raw[[1]], "EPSG:4326", method = "bilinear")
r_template <- flip(r_template, direction = "vertical")

writeRaster(r_template, out_tif, overwrite = TRUE)

print(r_template)
print(ext(r_template))
print(res(r_template))
print(names(r_template))
```

``` {r}
#----------------------------------
# Build full PRISM master grid
#----------------------------------
grid_df <- as.data.frame(r_template, xy = TRUE, cells = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)

names(grid_df)[names(grid_df) == "cell"] <- "prism_cell"
names(grid_df)[names(grid_df) == "x"] <- "lon"
names(grid_df)[names(grid_df) == "y"] <- "lat"

grid_df <- grid_df |>
  mutate(grid_id = seq_len(n())) |>
  select(grid_id, prism_cell, lon, lat)

grid_sf <- st_as_sf(grid_df, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)

# save master grid
write_parquet(grid_df, out_parquet)
write.csv(grid_df, out_csv, row.names = FALSE)

if (file.exists(out_gpkg)) file.remove(out_gpkg)
st_write(grid_sf, out_gpkg, delete_dsn = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)

if (file.exists(out_shp)) file.remove(out_shp)
st_write(grid_sf, out_shp, delete_layer = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)

cat("\nMaster grid rows:\n")
print(nrow(grid_df))

cat("\nMaster grid latitude range:\n")
print(range(grid_df$lat))

cat("\nMaster grid outputs:\n")
cat(out_parquet, "\n")
cat(out_csv, "\n")
cat(out_gpkg, "\n")
cat(out_shp, "\n")
cat(out_tif, "\n")
#----------------------------------
# Function to rectify + flip + extract one PRISM variable
#----------------------------------
extract_prism_var <- function(nc_file) {
  r_raw <- rast(nc_file)
  
  r_fix <- project(r_raw[[1]], "EPSG:4326", method = "bilinear")
  r_fix <- flip(r_fix, direction = "vertical")
  
  df <- as.data.frame(r_fix, xy = TRUE, cells = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  names(df)[names(df) == "cell"] <- "prism_cell"
  names(df)[names(df) == "x"] <- "lon"
  names(df)[names(df) == "y"] <- "lat"
  
  var_name <- names(r_fix)[1]
  
  df <- df |>
    select(prism_cell, all_of(var_name))
  
  return(df)
}

#----------------------------------
# Extract and merge all 3 PRISM variables
#----------------------------------
prism_list <- lapply(prism_files, extract_prism_var)

prism_vars_df <- Reduce(
  function(x, y) full_join(x, y, by = "prism_cell"),
  prism_list
)

grid_cov_df <- grid_df |>
  left_join(prism_vars_df, by = "prism_cell")

print(names(grid_cov_df))
print(head(grid_cov_df))

```


``` {r}
#----------------------------------
# Save merged PRISM covariate table
#----------------------------------
grid_cov_sf <- st_as_sf(grid_cov_df, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)

write_parquet(grid_cov_df, out_prism_parquet)
write.csv(grid_cov_df, out_prism_csv, row.names = FALSE)

if (file.exists(out_prism_gpkg)) file.remove(out_prism_gpkg)
st_write(grid_cov_sf, out_prism_gpkg, delete_dsn = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)

if (file.exists(out_prism_shp)) file.remove(out_prism_shp)
st_write(grid_cov_sf, out_prism_shp, delete_layer = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)

cat("\nMerged PRISM rows:\n")
print(nrow(grid_cov_df))

cat("\nMerged PRISM latitude range:\n")
print(range(grid_cov_df$lat))

cat("\nMerged PRISM outputs:\n")
cat(out_prism_parquet, "\n")
cat(out_prism_csv, "\n")
cat(out_prism_gpkg, "\n")
cat(out_prism_shp, "\n")

#----------------------------------
# Final checks
#----------------------------------
summary(grid_cov_df$tmax)
summary(grid_cov_df$tmin)
summary(grid_cov_df$precip)

cat("\nFinal columns:\n")
print(names(grid_cov_df))

```
